maria: FYI opened PR to update Aegis2 model card: fixing sequence_limit, adding runtime compatibility notes, and swapping a broken benchmark link. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/491
sam: can you paste the exact bench URL? the card had two variants and one goes to a 404

tara: skimmed the diff  two quick things: 1) example SDK snippet needs to show chunking/stream fallback for long context 2) add a short ROCm kernel compatibility note
oliver: +1 on ROCm note. suggest: "ROCm tested on Linux kernel 4.19+; older kernels may hit driver ABI issues"
maria: added that line under compatibility. also changed sequence_limit from 4096 -> 8192 per bench team
sam: i'll update the Go snippet and run the examples test. tara, can you share the python chunking example you want?
tara: putting the python example here (will go in the PR):

``
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
text = open('huge_prompt.txt').read()
for chunk in client.chunk(text, max_tokens=4000):
    for token in client.stream(model='aegis2', prompt=chunk):
        print(token, end='')
```

Use `client.chunk()` and `client.stream()` so the snippet matches runtime fallback behavior

sam: nice. i'll port that pattern to Go and add a short comment about preserving KV cache between chunks
